ordinaryModes.owner: App.mapInteractionMode (local React state; not a new persisted enum)

choices.label: Inspect
choices.meaning: Open the read-only contextual inspector for a map entity.
choices.mapClick: Cell clicks open the inspector. No plan selection or RF request is triggered by inspection.

choices.label: Select cells
choices.meaning: In Network mode, toggle a Cell in the selected cluster.
choices.mapClick: Toggles existing Network membership semantics; does not open the inspector. The explicit Evaluate Network action remains the compute boundary.

ordinaryModes.accessibleState: Text-labelled buttons in a named Map interaction mode group with aria-pressed and a check icon; on phones a labelled disclosure names the active mode.

specialTools.availableWhen: Network mode and Select cells interaction are active.
specialTools.activeFeedback: Draw area, live status text, point instruction, Finish, and Cancel.
specialTools.completion: Existing polygon logic selects up to six nearest cells within the drawn area; fewer than two found does not create an evaluable cluster.
specialTools.cancel: Escape or Cancel drops the in-progress polygon and restores the underlying Select cells mode.

specialTools.availableWhen: The Inventory workflow arms cell placement.
specialTools.activeFeedback: Place cell, click instruction, and Cancel replace the ordinary mode controls.
specialTools.completion: Places the existing manual inventory cell and exits placement.

specialTools.availableWhen: The existing Path Profile workflow arms receiver picking.
specialTools.activeFeedback: Pick receiver, click instruction, and Cancel replace the ordinary mode controls.
specialTools.completion: Sets the receiver endpoint; analysis remains an explicit action.

specialTools.meaning: Immediate destructive cluster edit; clears selected membership and network azimuths and invalidates results as before.
Changes the Leaflet viewport only. Does not set Map Focus or mutate the plan.

priority.mapClick: Any armed special tool consumes the map click before ordinary Inspect/Select cells handling. Area points, placement, and endpoint selection retain their existing owning handlers.
escape: Cancel armed path receiver selection, area drawing, or placement.
Close Layers, View, or interaction disclosures; the active disclosure trigger regains focus.
Return ordinary Select cells to Inspect.
Dismiss the stage chooser, then close the task drawer according to existing behavior.
priority.restoration: Special modes are separate ephemeral booleans layered over the ordinary mode. Completing/cancelling returns to the still-current ordinary mode; no serialized mode was added.

networkSelection.wording: At least 2 cells are required to evaluate; 6 is the maximum cluster size.
networkSelection.primaryAction: Select cells appears only while more cells are needed and selection mode is not already active; Evaluate Network appears when the plan is ready.

setupSynchronization: The existing Setup Select cells on map action arms Select cells. While active, Setup changes to Selecting cells on map…; during area drawing it says Drawing selection area…. At widths of 900px and below, the Setup sheet closes after the entry action so map cells remain available; reopening Setup shows the active status rather than a duplicate entry action.
mutationBoundary: Only existing Select cells, area selection, placement, clear, and Inventory edits mutate plan data. Inspect, Map Focus, Scope, Layers, and Fit remain presentation/navigation actions.
persistence: No interaction-mode enum, popover state, or special-tool state is written to project/domain persistence. Existing Map Focus/ray Scope map presentation handling is preserved.
